title: coder lib test two_principal_queue_reorder_and_release_keep_current_admission times out under full-suite load
body: `crates/coder/src/task/remote_control_tests.rs::two_principal_queue_reorder_and_release_keep_current_admission` hits its 5-second call timeout when the full `cargo test -p coder --lib` runs under load, and passes when run alone. The fixed 5 s bound per host call is too tight for a loaded machine running the whole lib suite on a 2-worker runtime. Make it wait on the condition with a generous bound (or fix a real ordering race) and prove it with two full lib runs.
